channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Pros and Cons of the Detroit Lions Hiring Arthur Smith as OC
item.description: Could Arthur Smith be the Detroit Lions’ next offensive coordinator? We break down the pros and cons of hiring the former Falcons head coach, his fit with Jared Goff, and why his scheme could unlock Sam LaPorta and Brock Wright.

item.title: Detroit Lions Land Blindside Protector in Dane Brugler’s Latest Mock Draft
item.description: Dane Brugler projects Utah LT Caleb Lomu to the Detroit Lions in his 2026 NFL Mock Draft as a potential successor to veteran Taylor Decker.

item.title: Detroit Lions Crystal Ball: Will Alex Anzalone Be a Lion in 2026?
item.description: Alex Anzalone is a team captain and defensive leader, but will the Detroit Lions be able to afford him in 2026? A crystal ball look at his future.

item.title: Detroit Lions Crystal Ball: Will Al-Quadin Muhammad Be a Lion in 2026?
item.description: Al-Quadin Muhammad is coming off an 11-sack breakout season in Detroit. Can the Lions afford to keep him in 2026, or will free agency pull him away?

item.title: Michigan S Rod Moore Announces Decision for 2026
item.description: Veteran safety Rod Moore will return to Michigan for a sixth season after overcoming knee injuries, giving the Wolverines a proven leader and playmaker in 2026.

item.title: Key Detroit Lions Defender Makes Himself Crystal Clear: ‘I loved every minute of it’
item.description: Detroit Lions defensive tackle Roy Lopez says he is “very open” to returning in 2026, praising Dan Campbell, the locker room, and a career-best season in Detroit.

item.title: Rumor: Potential Detroit Lions Free Agent Crush Wants $20 Million Per Season
item.description: Tyler Linderbaum is rumored to be seeking $20 million per season, which would make him the highest-paid center in NFL history. Could the Detroit Lions make a move?

item.title: Why NFL Playoff Underdogs Could Shape the 2026 Postseason
item.description: The NFL playoffs are defined by uncertainty. Regular-season success earns teams a place in the bracket, but once the postseason begins, outcomes are often decided by small moments rather than long-term trends. That reality has repeatedly opened the door for…

item.title: Examining How Detroit Lions Can Restructure Jared Goff’s Contract to Free Up $30 Million in Cap Space
item.description: A full breakdown of how the Detroit Lions can restructure Jared Goff’s contract and create over $30 million in 2026 salary cap space to fuel a Super Bowl push.

item.title: New York Jets Interview Detroit Lions Assistant Coach
item.description: Detroit Lions defensive assistant Jim O’Neil has interviewed for the New York Jets’ defensive coordinator position, potentially reuniting with head coach Aaron Glenn.
